description:
Wapoo is a playable social video app where you twist videos with friends, create new outcomes, and turn one moment into endless possibilities:
1. See something you want to change? Twist it. Take the moment somewhere unexpected, then pass it to a friend and see where they take it next.

2. Start a Touchdown with your friends and keep it moving from person to person. Every completed Touchdown pushes your school forward in the Rivalry. Your friends build the chain. Your school fights for the lead.

3. Every Twist becomes part of a bigger story. Open the What-If Galaxy to explore all the different paths, versions, and endings that grow from one moment.

4. On Wapoo, videos keep moving between people. A game-day moment can become something impossible. A night out can turn into five completely different endings. Your friend can change your version, and someone else can take theirs somewhere totally new.

What you can do on Wapoo:
• Twist videos into new outcomes
• Pass Twists between friends
• Complete Touchdowns together
• Compete for your school in Rivalries
• Explore every path in the What-If Galaxy
• Discover endless versions of the same moment
Others scroll. We twist.
Twist the moment. Pass it on. See where it goes.

reviewSample.text: Yesterday I was introduced to this app because my friend was working for them as intern. I downloaded the app at home and all the family members were attracted by the playable content. It was quite unexpected but we ended up playing relay videos at the family gathering for the whole night, and even my grandma is having a lot of fun with the Wapoo app. Ik it’s the football season so they are trying to do promotions on World Cup but I would rather say it’s a party app just like all these board games. It’s very fun to turn your friend into a dolphin or tung tung tung sahur.

💭Downloaded this to watch funny UGC videos and try making my own AI videos in the relay. Did NOT expect to accidentally sculpt a six-pack. After 20 minutes of scrolling I had laughed so hard my abs gave up, submitted a formal resignation letter, and began filing for disability. A solid week of ab workouts right there >o<😄😄😄😄

5 stars.🤧🤧🙉🙉 Would recommend to anyone looking for entertainment, community, or an alternative to crunches. Warning: do not watch while drinking anything.👅👅👅

I was getting a bit bored of just scrolling through passive video feeds, so this was a fun change of pace. It’s actually pretty cool to be able to influence the outcome of the clips rather than just watching them. As seen in Wapoo, the concept of turning video into a playable experience really adds a new layer to how I consume content. Definitely worth a download if you want something more engaging.

I’ve been looking for an app like this for a while. The playable feature is very cool, and I really love the core idea of the playable video. However, I think the app will be better if there could be more templates for users as references of creation, and also more completed video for watching but not creating. Hope the community could be built up soon so I can find more fun videos to interact with.

Ok so you know how you see a random vid on your fyp and you’re like “what if the next frame was something completely unhinged”? yeah this app literally does that. It takes the last frame of any video and AI just… keeps going. Sounds simple but it’s actually so cursed in the best way.

why it slaps:

· Low effort, high wow – You don’t need editing skills.
· Hilariously unpredictable – One frame can go horror, comedy, or trippy… just any abstract.
· Built-in social pressure (in a fun way) – Replying to a friend’s video with your continuation feels like a creative flex. Everyone is a creator!

⭐️

One of the most interesting interactive video apps I’ve seen. Smooth, immersive experience and the conversation flows naturally. The battle between schools function is a huge plus as well. Supper fun and playable. Definitely worth trying!!
This app is actually super fun. I like that you can jump into a video and decide what happens next instead of just scrolling. The playable video idea feels new, and it’s easy to get creative.
What an interesting and advanced concept! This app could definitely take off and become the next big thing. I would recommend that anyone gets involved and tries it out.
